title: Jesus... Everyone At The Wedding Asked When It's My Turn
topic: relatives asking when it is her turn at a family wedding

bible.text: Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... four aunties asked me the same question today: when is it my turn? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It was a wedding. I was happy for the couple. But I left feeling like I'm behind.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You smiled for every photo and cried in the car on the way home. I was in that car too.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Am I doing life wrong? Did I miss some deadline God set for me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: There is no deadline with your name on it. Their calendar is not your calling.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But everyone from my class is settling down one by one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Let them. Your story is not late. It is being written with more care than you can see tonight.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just don't want to show up at the next one still explaining myself.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You never owe anyone an update on your life. Delight yourself in Me, and the rest arrives in its season.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your turn is not a seat at someone else's table. I'm setting a whole table for you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What question are you tired of answering? 🙏
